record.question: In how many phase will the ensuing General Election to the Lok Sabha be conducted?
record.explanation: Answer B: Seven. The ensuing election is the 2019 election to the 17 th Lok Sabha. ECI records that its schedule was announced on 10 March 2019 and polling was divided into seven phases, from 11 April to 19 May. Thus Seven is the date-appropriate choice. Historical/source note: Historical April 2019 question; ensuing refers to that election, not an election after the present reading date. Reference: https://www.eci.gov.in/EBooks/Leap-of-Faith/files/basic-html/page154.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
